messages:
anna_ml: heads-up — during the new model bring-up (magna-14B quant trial) I hit a reproducible divergence when using long prefixes + streaming state.
anna_ml: baseline (fp16) ok, int4 path shows token drift after ~4k tokens.
anna_ml: quick repro steps: 1) load checkpoint v0.9; 2) run long prefix script with --streaming-cache; 3) resume with additional 500 tokens.
anna_ml: log snippet:```
[stream] idx=4096 resume->cache_index=4096 state_hash=0x9a7c3
[gen ] token=4097 text="and then"
[stream] idx=4097 resume->cache_index=4096 state_hash=0x1f2e9
[gen ] token=4098 text="but"
```
sam_infra: curious — are you using the new attention-buffer flush optimization? (the one we toggled last week)
sam_infra: also which kernel config: fused-attn-v2 or fallback?
anna_ml: fused-attn-v2, and flush enabled via ATTN_BUFFER_FLUSH=1 in the job.
anna_ml: I tried with flush=0 and still saw drift but onset shifts (starts ~6k instead of 4k).
javier_research: tagging a hypothesis: the rotary position scaling we applied for longer windows might interact with the compacted attention cache index when quantized.
javier_research: int4 quant packs the KV tensors — small rounding error could push the effective rotation index, leading to phase offset over many steps.
tina_oncall: @anna_ml can you drop full tensor checksums for KV at 4k/4k+1/4k+2 and attach? I can run a sanity job on Dedicated.
anna_ml: attaching checksums (pastes below) — these are sha1 of flattened float tensors before packing:```
KV@4096: sha1=3f8b2a...
KV@4097: sha1=3f8b2a...
KV@4098: sha1=9c1d7f...
```
anna_ml: notice KV@4096/4097 identical then flips at 4098 — suggests index aliasing in the buffer.
sam_infra: could be wrap/stride bug in the streaming circular buffer. I remember an off-by-one in the new stride calc if seq_len % tile_size == 0.
sam_infra: quick check: can you run with DEBUG_STREAM=1 and reduced tile_size=128? command: `./run_long_prefix.sh --tile-size 128 --debug-stream`
javier_research: another quick experiment: run same input on fp16 and int8 (not int4) to see if error magnitude is quant-level dependent.
tina_oncall: I'll queue a Dedicated run in the next slot (ETA ~15m) with both configs, and leave ATTN_BUFFER_FLUSH=0/1 permutations.
deploy-bot: job queued: cluster/dedicated-magna-1 — job id 987654321.
anna_ml: thanks — also capturing prompt/assistant parity diffs: small token substitutions at ~4098 onward — I'll drop a minimal diff artifact to the ticket.
sam_infra: if the reduced tile-size removes it, that points at tiling math. If it persists across fp16/int8 then likely index tracking.
javier_research: if we confirm index aliasing, mitigation could be: 1) swap to absolute indexing for the buffer, or 2) add guard tokens so wrap only at safe boundaries.
tina_oncall: job finished: job id 987654321 -> failed with OOM on int8 run, fp16 complete. Logs: `/artifacts/987654321/logs/stream-debug.log`
anna_ml: downloading logs now, will paste the critical snippet.
anna_ml: fp16 run still clean. int4 reproducible on dev smaller machine too when using the packed-pipeline kernel.
sam_infra: ok let's bisect kernel change: repro with packed-pipeline v1 vs v0.9. If v0.9 fine, then regression introduced in v1 packing stride patch.
javier_research: to preserve production, add an automatic fallback: if checksum mismatch detected at resume, rehydrate KV to fp16 for next 64 tokens before switching back to quant. Could mask issue while we fix.
tina_oncall: noted — I'll open a quick PR for fallback and an alert on checksum divergence.
anna_ml: thanks all — next steps: run sam's tile-size debug, javier to run kernel bisect, tina to PR the fallback. I'll update thread with artifact links. :thumbsup:
